subject: Friday run: callback log before any new bank accounts
text:
Team,

Before Friday's ACH run please make sure every vendor whose bank account was touched this month has a completed callback entry in the VM-7 log. Treasury will not release the batch otherwise. Currently missing: none, as far as I can see, but double-check Hollis and Kestrel since both were set up recently.

Also, reminder that we do not accept bank changes by email alone. If a vendor emails, send them the form and do the callback.

Karen
label: ordinary
